meta.narrative_direction: 부정형 — 「베이징이 계획서대로 사람을 밀어내 제 도시를 스스로 비웠다」는 자업자득 서사(concept.md 앵글 / verified-data §C 「以房管人·以业控人」·상한 2,300만을 넘은 적 없음). 단 verified-data §8의 안전선(「중국이 무너진다」가 아니라 「만드는 힘은 남았는데 도시에서 사람이 빠졌다」)을 지켜 국기를 통째로 태우지 않는다 — 탈색·먼지·그을린 가장자리·해진 자락으로만 처리하고, 실제 화염은 2017년 신젠촌 화재를 다루는 3번 한 장에만 쓴다. 지배색은 화염 오렌지가 아니라 죽은 회청 야경 + 오성홍기 적색이다. 한국이 등장하지 않는 제3국 내부 서사이므로 「대립 구도 소재 — 우리 쪽 얼굴」 표는 적용하지 않고, 전경은 국가원수(시진핑)와 제복 집행 집단으로만 세운다.

meta.prompt_prefix: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the scene fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge as a single full-bleed image — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is the same continuous scene rendered dark, smoky and free of detail so overlay text stays readable, while all faces, flags, weapons and key objects sit entirely within the upper five-eighths. Anything held or carried sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. photoreal current-affairs broadcast composite: every person, flag and location is a real photograph, sharp and true to life — faces keep real skin texture, pores, stray hair and natural shadow, and fabric keeps a visible weave. Over that photographic base sit broadcast graphic treatments: a bold colour field, cracked-glass shards, torn and scorched edges, a hard vignette, heavy atmospheric haze and fire glow. Dramatic hard lighting, one dominant colour drowning the frame, every part of the upper five-eighths packed edge to edge with elements and no empty space, cinematic wide-angle, very high contrast. NOT an oil painting, NOT brushwork or impasto, NOT a matte painting, NOT anime, NOT an illustration, NOT a 3d render
meta.prompt_suffix: no title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no lower-third news banner, no watermark. Apart from the Korean Hangul labels and numerals named above — which must be rendered crisply and correctly as real Korean letterforms — do not invent any other words or letterforms anywhere in the image.
meta.negative_prompt: oil painting, brushwork, impasto, painterly, matte painting, illustration, anime, 3d render, cartoon, english text, latin letters, fake chinese characters, gibberish text, random lettering, invented words, glowing eyes, glowing red eyes, rising-sun flag, damaged South Korean flag

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「밤이 됐는데 창문에 불이 안 켜진다.」 verified-data §H 「불 꺼진 아파트 야경」 + §4 베이징 상주인구 2년 연속 감소(2,183.2만→2,180.0만)가 근거다. 부정형 판정 근거 — 도시가 비어가는 국면이므로 국기는 탈색·해진 상태, 지배색은 죽은 회청 야경. 물증을 못 믿는 시청자에게 「불빛의 부재」라는 반박 어려운 그림을 먼저 던진다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Xi Jinping is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his hair touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right; every other element is far smaller. Scene: an enormous Chinese national flag — a red field with one large yellow five-pointed star and four smaller yellow stars in an arc beside it — hangs as real heavy woven cloth across the whole left two-thirds of the background from top to bottom, its red drained and grimy, its lower edge frayed and soot-stained, deep folds throwing true photographic shadow. In front of it, filling the middle of the frame, three huge night-time residential tower blocks are photographed head-on from across a wide empty boulevard at standing eye level, their window grids almost entirely black — out of hundreds of windows only two carry a warm yellow light. A low granite estate marker at the near kerb is turned face-on to the camera and reads "베이징" in Korean Hangul in large clean letters, while any smaller notices on it are printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Xi Jinping (President of China) stands directly in front of the flag on the right, lit by a cold blue key light with a faint red bounce off the cloth, his eyelids heavy and low, his gaze unfocused and cast down away from the towers, his lips pressed into one hard flat line and the muscle at his jaw drawn tight, no hands in frame. Dominant colour is a dead blue-grey city night drowning the frame with the flag's red as the only warm accent, under a black smoke-choked sky.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「간판은 그대로인데 문만 벽돌로 사라졌다.」 verified-data §6 「개장타동(开墙打洞) 정비」 — 2017년 계획 1.6만 곳인데 8월 말까지 실제 2.3만 곳을 벽돌로 봉했다. 시장의 결과가 아니라 누군가의 결정임을 보여주는 컷이라 전경을 무명 상인이 아니라 국가를 대표하는 제복 집행 집단으로 세웠다(무명 민간인 금지 규칙).
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the nearest uniformed officer is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his cap touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right; the officers behind him are far smaller, roughly one third of his head height, and progressively hazier. Scene: a narrow Beijing shopfront alley photographed straight on from the middle of the street at standing eye level. Along the entire left side the ground-floor shop entrances have been filled in with fresh raw brick and wet grey mortar so the door openings are gone, while the old shop signboards still hang above them completely untouched. A public notice sheet is pasted on the new brickwork beside the nearest sealed doorway, turned face-on to the camera; its header reads "정비 대상" in Korean Hangul in large clean letters and the individual lines beneath it are printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Behind the alley an enormous Chinese national flag — a red field with one large yellow five-pointed star and four smaller yellow stars in an arc beside it — hangs as real heavy woven cloth across the entire background, its red dusty and drained, its edges frayed and soot-grey, the stars still fully readable. A short column of Chinese urban-management enforcement officers in grey uniform caps stands down the right side; the nearest one looks straight into the lens with narrowed eyes, eyebrows flat and unmoved, lips closed in a level expressionless line, one gloved hand still resting a mason's trowel on a wet brick course. Dominant colour is flat overcast concrete grey drowning the frame with the flag's red as the only colour, hard side light raking across the new brickwork.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 「불이 난 다음 날부터 사람을 치웠다.」 verified-data §6 — 2017년 11월 18일 신젠촌 화재(19명 사망) 다음 날부터 40일 「대조사·대청소·대정비」, 관영 문건의 「低端人口」, 집행 수단은 수도·전기·가스 차단. 9장 중 유일하게 실제 화염을 쓰는 장이며 그 근거가 대본에 실재하는 화재라는 점이 판정 근거다. 쫓겨난 이주민은 전경에 세우지 않고 짐 실린 삼륜차 대열로만 남긴다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Xi Jinping is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his hair touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right; the vehicles behind are far smaller, roughly one third of his head height. Scene: the burnt-out edge of a low-rise migrant housing block on the outskirts of Beijing, photographed head-on from the road at standing eye level. Half the brick wall is already knocked down and the roof beams are charred black, while thin orange flame still eats along one collapsed section and heavy black smoke rolls up and fills the sky. On the one wall still standing, a large red painted notice reads "철거 대상" in Korean Hangul, the strokes wide enough to read from across the street. In the middle distance a line of three-wheeled cargo trikes and small trucks piled with mattresses and bundled clothing pulls away from the camera down the road, their shapes small and hazy in the smoke. An enormous Chinese national flag — a red field with one large yellow five-pointed star and four smaller yellow stars in an arc beside it — hangs as real heavy cloth across the background behind the smoke, its lower edge charred black and torn into ragged strips while the stars stay fully readable. Xi Jinping (President of China) stands in front of it on the right with firelight raking his face as a hard orange key, his eyes narrowed to a cold calculating slit, chin slightly lifted, mouth closed with the corners set flat and unmoved, no hands in frame. Dominant colour is fire orange and deep red drowning the frame.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목의 「20대 213만 명을 밀어낸」을 그대로 이행한다. verified-data §4 — 베이징 20대 461.8만(2015) → 248.9만(2024), -212.9만, 비중 21.3%→11.4%. 숫자를 큰 전광판(원래 큰 물건이므로 확대 콜아웃 없이 그냥 크게)으로 물리화하고, 그 앞 광장을 비워 「밀어낸 결과」를 같은 화면에 넣는다. 인물을 좌측에 세워 1·3번과 배치를 벌렸다.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목의 「계획서에 적힌 여덟 글자」를 이행한다. verified-data §C — 「베이징 도시총체계획(2016~2035)」의 상주인구 2,300만 상한과 「以房管人·以业控人」. 문서는 원래 작은 물건이라 확대 콜아웃 대상이지만, 콜아웃은 계승 3장(7~9)에 배정했으므로 여기서는 「원래 큰 것」인 청사 앞 대형 계획 게시판으로 바꿔 그냥 크게 그린다(확대 콜아웃과 소품 확대는 둘 중 하나만).

thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목의 「사람 제일 많다던 중국이 밀어냈다」의 결과 장면 — 「사람이 지워진 도시」를 도시 스케일로 이행한다. verified-data §H 「도시를 빠져나가는 이삿짐 트럭」 + §A 성 밖으로 나가는 이동이 줄고 성 안 이동이 느는 방향 전환이 근거. 9장 중 유일하게 인물이 없는 장이다 — 이 그림의 주인공은 얼굴이 아니라 「한 방향으로만 흐르는 차선」이고, 여기에 국가원수를 넣으면 도로 스케일이 죽는다. 무명 민간인으로 자리를 채우지 않는다는 규칙에 따라 사람 대신 국기·도로·차량으로 화면을 세웠다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE NOTE: there is no person in this frame — the flag and the roadway are the largest elements and each fills at least a third of the frame. Scene: a night-time arterial road leading out of Beijing, photographed from an overpass looking straight down the carriageway at a slight downward angle. The outbound lanes are packed bumper to bumper with box trucks, small movers' lorries and loaded pickups whose red tail lights trail away toward the dark horizon, while the inbound lanes beside them are completely empty black asphalt. A huge overhead gantry sign hangs face-on across the upper part of the road, its main panel reading "출구" in Korean Hangul in large clean letters that fill most of the panel width; the smaller destination rows beside it are printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Behind the road an enormous Chinese national flag — a red field with one large yellow five-pointed star and four smaller yellow stars in an arc beside it — hangs as real heavy woven cloth filling the entire background from top to bottom, its red drained to a dull rust, its edge frayed into ragged strips, deep folds catching the tail lights. Beyond the flag the city skyline stands with its window grids almost entirely unlit, only a handful of scattered lit windows in the whole horizon. Heavy smog haze cuts through the frame and a hard vignette crushes the corners; dominant colour is a dead blue-grey night drowning the frame with the flag's red and the rope of tail lights as the only warm elements.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 건물은 멀쩡히 다 서 있는데, 사람이 있어야 할 자리에 사람이 없다 — 빨간 원이 그 부재를 딱 한 곳만 지목한다 / [남김] 그 한 줄 모순 · 좌측 상단 빨간 확대 서클 + 굵은 빨간 화살표 · 현장 안쪽에 서지 않고 통로 정면을 마주 보는 카메라 · 우측 3분의 1의 초대형 주체와 경악 표정 / [바꿈] 피사체(무인 크레인 조종석 → 창고가 된 도매상가 점포) · 무대(실외 공사판 → 실내 도매상가 복도) · 관찰 디테일(퇴장 대열 → 셔터 앞에 쌓인 재고 박스와 꺼진 형광등). 거리감은 얼굴 중심으로 7·8과 벌렸다. 근거는 verified-data §1 차이 사장 「100곳 넘던 점포가 지금은 서너 곳, 나머지는 창고가 됐다」.
thumbnails.prompt_en: SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: Xi Jinping is the largest thing in the picture — his face fills the right third of the frame and alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his hair touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right; the corridor behind him recedes far smaller. Scene: the interior corridor of a Shanghai wholesale clothing market, photographed head-on down the aisle at standing eye level. Shutter after shutter is rolled down along the left, only one distant unit still lit, and stacked cardboard stock boxes crowd the closed shutters where customers should be standing; most of the ceiling fluorescent tubes are dead and the two that work throw a cold blue-green light. A hanging directory board at the top of the aisle is turned face-on and reads "의류 도매" in Korean Hangul in large clean letters, its smaller unit rows printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. A single bold red-outlined circular magnifier inset about one third of the frame width sits in the upper left, holding a sharp enlargement of one shuttered unit stuffed with boxes behind its half-raised shutter, and one thick red arrow runs from the circle to the exact unit it came from; the circle sits entirely within the upper five-eighths and never overlaps his face. An enormous Chinese national flag — a red field with one large yellow five-pointed star and four smaller yellow stars in an arc beside it — hangs as real heavy woven cloth filling the wall behind the aisle, drained and dust-grey with a frayed edge, and one small silhouette pushes a cart away at the far end. Xi Jinping (President of China) fills the right, his eyes stretched wide and sideways with the lower lids visibly trembling, a sheen of sweat across his forehead, his mouth clamped shut hard, no hands in frame. Dominant colour is a sick fluorescent blue-green drowning the frame with the flag's red and the red circle as the only warm elements.
